title: Std Move
description: Cast to rvalue reference to enable move semantics (C++11)
explanation: std::move casts an lvalue to an rvalue reference, enabling resource transfer instead of copying.

title: Std Forward
explanation: std::forward conditionally casts to rvalue, preserving the value category of forwarded arguments.

title: Std Exchange
description: Replace a value and return the old one atomically (C++14)
explanation: std::exchange sets a new value and returns the old one in one operation, useful in move semantics.

title: Std Clamp
description: Constrain a value between a minimum and maximum (C++17)
explanation: std::clamp restricts a value to [lo, hi]. Returns lo if value < lo, hi if value > hi, value otherwise.

title: Std Midpoint (C++20)
explanation: std::midpoint computes (a+b)/2 without overflow for integers and returns the midpoint of pointers.

title: Std Lerp (C++20)
explanation: std::lerp computes a + t * (b - a) with properties that guarantee exact results at t=0 and t=1.

title: Std Function Type Erasure
description: Store any callable with a compatible signature (C++11)
explanation: std::function provides type-erased storage for any callable target with a compatible signature.

title: Std Bind And Placeholders
description: Bind arguments to callables for partial application (C++11)
explanation: std::bind creates a callable with some arguments pre-bound using placeholders ( _1, _2, etc.)

title: Std Ref And Creff
description: Create reference wrappers for pass-by-reference semantics (C++11)
explanation: std::ref and std::cref create reference_wrapper objects that can be stored in containers and passed by reference.

title: Typeid Operator
description: Query type information at runtime using typeid (C++11)
explanation: typeid returns type_info for runtime type identification. For polymorphic types, it respects dynamic type.

title: Alignas And Alignof
explanation: alignas forces alignment of a variable/type; alignof queries the alignment requirement of a type.

title: Placement New
explanation: Placement new constructs an object at a specific memory address without allocating new storage.

title: Std Reduce (C++17)
explanation: std::reduce is like accumulate but supports parallel execution and non-deterministic evaluation order.

title: Transform Reduce
description: Apply a transformation, then reduce (map-reduce pattern) (C++17)
explanation: transform_reduce applies a transform function to each element pair, then reduces the results.

title: Partial Sum And Scan
description: Compute prefix sums with sequential or parallel scan (C++17)
explanation: Scans compute prefix (cumulative) operations. inclusive_scan includes the current element, exclusive_scan excludes it.

title: Adjacent Difference
explanation: adjacent_difference computes differences between consecutive elements, the discrete analog of derivatives.

title: Inner Product
description: Compute inner product (dot product) of two ranges
explanation: inner_product computes a generalized dot product: transform pairs, then reduce, defaulting to multiply-add.

title: Iota (C++11)
description: Fill a range with sequentially increasing values (C++11)
explanation: std::iota fills a range with incrementing values starting from a given initial value.

title: Iomanip Advanced Formatting
explanation: iomanip provides stream manipulators for precise control over output formatting.
